questions.q: In "Choose the customer and the need Define", which of these is a key idea?
o: Write the one-page business plan with customer, offer, price and break-even.
Describe one customer by who, where, how often they buy and what they spend.
Ask each customer one question after purchase.
List fixed costs per month and variable cost per unit.

questions.q: In "Shape the offer Create", which of these is a key idea?
o: Choose where customers can find and buy easily.
Divide spend by customers to get cost per customer.
Keep the first offer small: one product or one package.
Write the need in the customer words.

questions.q: In "Costs, price and break-even Apply", which of these is a key idea?
o: Write a promise you can keep every time.
Calculate break-even units: fixed cost divided by price minus variable cost.
Stop the costlier channel if results stay poor.
Follow consumer protection and advertising rules in India.

questions.q: In "The marketing mix Apply", which of these is a key idea?
o: Write a promise you can keep every time.
List risks and what you will do if sales fall short.
Stop the costlier channel if results stay poor.
Pick promotion that fits the customer, such as a local group, a shop board or a short video.

questions.q: In "Honest messages and rules Evaluate", which of these is a key idea?
o: Write a promise you can keep every time.
Stop the costlier channel if results stay poor.
Show price, quantity and conditions clearly.
Choose two channels to test, such as a messaging group and a flyer.

questions.q: In "Channels and cost per customer Analyse", which of these is a key idea?
o: Ask each customer one question after purchase.
Track spend and new customers for each channel.
List fixed costs per month and variable cost per unit.
Choose where customers can find and buy easily.

questions.q: In "Sales, repeat buyers and feedback Evaluate", which of these is a key idea?
o: Describe product, price, place and promotion in one line each.
Track spend and new customers for each channel.
Name two alternatives the customer already uses.
Count sales per week and the share who buy again.

questions.q: In "Capstone: 90-day plan Create", which of these is a key idea?
o: Write a promise you can keep every time.
List risks and what you will do if sales fall short.
Make only claims you can prove, with a source.
Name two alternatives the customer already uses.
